blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — STI Education Systems Holdings Inc. earned P2.01 billion in the 2025–2026 school year, supported by tertiary enrollment as the group continued spending on campuses and learning technologies. The Eusebio Tanco-led private school reported revenues of P5.55 billion and a net income margin of 36 percent, according to a stock exchange filing on Wednesday.
